title: Workspace
subtitle: Connect a Workspace and manage installation and approval policy.
tokenPolicy: GitHub tokens are kept in sessionStorage only.

github.title: GitHub repository connection
github.subtitle: Connect the GitHub repository that backs this Workspace.

installation.title: Workspace installation
installation.subtitle: Manage the installation required by this Workspace.
installation.idle: Check the connection to inspect installation status.
installation.installSuccess: Installation request is ready for maintainer review. Installation remains unchanged until applied.
installation.updateSuccess: Update request is ready for maintainer review. Installation remains unchanged until applied.

workspacePolicy.title: Workspace policy
workspacePolicy.subtitle: Request a change to the Workspace approval policy.
workspacePolicy.idle: Check the connection to inspect Workspace policy.
workspacePolicy.selfApprovalNotice: Requester self-approval will be allowed after this policy change is applied. Approval remains explicit evidence.
workspacePolicy.autoApproveNotice: After this policy change is applied, Workspace policy automatically approves execution requests and permits self-approval. Explicit approval evidence is recorded; execution remains controlled by the connected platform.
workspacePolicy.pendingRequest: The policy request has not been applied.
